name: Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa - Gulf Shores
description: Since 2004, Hand & Stone has been providing best-in-class personalized spa treatments, therapeutic massages, and individualized skincare services. Our philosophy is simple: because we specialize in high quality, customized massage or facial services at affordable prices, we can make the soothing wonder of the massage or facial experience accessible to more and more people. That turns a massage or facial into a truly affordable luxury that is so good for you. Hand & Stone boasts more than 600 spas throughout the US and Canada. Launched in 2005 by a passionate physical therapist, John Marco, the Hand & Stone concept is the leading spa concept in the world thanks to our commitment to providing great, good for you services, affordably and in a safe and convenient way. We strive to make your spa experience beneficial to both mind and body. Our service menu offers a wide variety of massage modalities to choose from. Each massage therapist has access to detailed training in advancing their knowledge of massage. We pride ourselves on maintaining the traditions of old when it comes to offering stone based services. Hot Stone massage is our signature service. The perfectly heated basalt stones work deep into tight overwork worked muscles relieving pain. Himalayan salt stones are noted for their response to the nervous system and cold marble stones aid inflammation. At Hand & Stone, our licensed estheticians help clients achieve their skincare goals, with a unique treatment solution for each condition. We have a facial for any skin type or concern and our skincare PROs will assist you in finding the perfect fit for you.
